TSchematicView.SelectedPolygon.text: The selected polygon, when exactly one object is selected and it is a polygon.

TSchematicView.PolygonTolerance.text: How close to a handle a click has to be to pick it: 2 design units, but never less than 4 pixels, so a handle can still be picked when the sheet is zoomed out.

TSchematicView.PolygonAction.text: Does one of the polygon menu's actions (Add handle, Delete handle, Free line, Arc in, Arc out, Curve) on the selected polygon, at the clicked point, as one undo step. Nothing is recorded if it changed nothing.

TSchematicView.SetDrawArcType.text: Chooses the kind of segment (straight, arc in, arc out) given to the points of a polygon that is drawn from now on.

TSchematicView.ShowPolygonMenu.text: Opens the menu for a selected polygon at the mouse: Add handle, Delete handle, Free line, Arc in, Arc out, Curve, then Undo and Redo, as TinyCAD's polygon edit menu.

params.P: the point clicked, on the sheet

TSchematicView.PolyMenuClick.text: Handler for the items of the polygon menu: Undo and Redo, or one of the polygon actions at the point where the menu was opened.

TSchematicView.ShowDrawMenu.text: Opens the menu for a polygon that is being drawn: Finish polygon, Cancel drawing, and the kind of segment for the points still to come (Free line, Arc in, Arc out, the current one marked).

TSchematicView.DrawMenuClick.text: Handler for the items of the drawing menu: finish the polygon, cancel it, or choose the kind of segment.

polytest.pas::RI.text: A random whole number from Lo to Hi.

polytest.pas::Absolute.text: The positions of a polygon's handles on the sheet (their stored positions are relative to its origin).

polytest.pas::Same.text: Whether two points are the same to within a millionth.

polytest.pas::Snap10.text: Snaps a coordinate to the 10 unit grid (halves round up).

polytest.pas::MakePolygon.text: Makes a random polygon: three to eight handles on the grid, each (but the first) straight, an arc in, an arc out or a curve with a control point, open or closed.

polytest.pas::CheckSound.text: Checks that a polygon is in a sound state: two handles at least, its origin the top left of its bounding box, and every handle and flattened point inside the box.

params.Where: what has just been done, for messages

polytest.pas::RoundTrip.text: Saves a polygon as XML, loads it again and checks the same handles, arc types and control points come back.

polytest.pas::OneRun.text: One random polygon put through 25 random steps (a handle drag, or a menu action at a random click), with every rule of the file header checked after each step.
